Method of Attack: Information-stealing malware that harvests account credentials, system and app data
Uses a downloader to check for security software and malware analysis tools before downloading payload
Steals data from Firefox, Thunderbird, MobaXTerm, PuTTY, SSH known hosts, and Windows Vault passwords
Uses AES encryption with hardcoded keys to communicate with C2 server over port 443
Impacted Systems: Systems running Firefox, Thunderbird, MobaXTerm, PuTTY
Windows systems with Windows Vault password manager
Indicators of Compromise: Process names checked: BurpSuite, Charles, Fiddler, rpcapd, smsniff, Wireshark, x96dbg, ollydbg, idag
